request: Pick whichever fitting one costs the least, please. My roommate Dana asked me to pick up a clock for our hallway, and she's got feelings about what goes on that wall. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). (I figured a clock's a clock, but I'll be fair, she's lived here longer.) That wall is the first thing folks see coming in, like the overlook at the top of a trail, so whatever I pick sets the tone. Only count what you've got on hand in the store, not what's just listed on some website somewhere (I've been burned by that before). It's a clock I'm after, and the shape's got to be square (I'll check it myself, don't worry, I ain't taking anybody's word on faith). Nothing over 725 cts, y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves, and every penny counts for me, like every step on a steep climb). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

rules: Only count items on hand in the store, not website listings.
If nothing fits, say so; do not offer substitutes.
